title: elatostema filicoides var. vitiense
intro: Elatostema filicoides var. vitiense, commonly known as the New Caledonian Polynesian shield fern, is a plant species in the family Urticaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in traditional medicine to alleviate symptoms of various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Elatostema filicoides var. vitiense are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. However, there is limited research available on this plant species, and further studies are needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human consumption.
